governing_question: What is the correct algebraic object underlying the TC arithmetic grids, and does analytic TC dilation preserve that object or force it outside its canonical algebraic-grade domain?

graded_arithmetic_object.definition: M_tau = A_R x Z_{!=0} (A_R-graded commutative monoid, direct product of (A_R, +) and (Z_{!=0}, *))
graded_arithmetic_object.grading_structure: M_tau = bigsqcup_{K in A_R} M_{tau, K} where M_{tau, K} = {K} x Z_{!=0}

realization_map.definition: Phi_tau: M_tau -> R^x, Phi_tau(K, n) = n * tau^K
realization_map.homomorphism_property: Phi_tau((K, n) * (J, m)) = Phi_tau(K, n) * Phi_tau(J, m)
realization_map.image: Phi_tau(M_tau) = L_tau = bigcup_{K in A_R} L_K (multiplicative submonoid of R^x)

injectivity_status.rational_grade_differences: PROVED_INJECTIVE: For K - J in Q\{0}, tau^{K-J} is transcendental (Lindemann 1882), so tau^{K-J} != m/n for all m, n in Z\{0}.
injectivity_status.irrational_algebraic_grade_differences: OPEN_TAU_ALGEBRAIC_EXPONENT_ARITHMETIC: Gelfond-Schneider does not apply directly to tau = 2pi; collision status remains open.
injectivity_status.coordinate_independence: The abstract monoid M_tau is well-defined and free of collisions regardless of whether Phi_tau is globally injective.

prime_factorization.irreducible_elements: Irr(M_tau) = { (K, +-p) : K in A_R, p in P }
prime_factorization.canonical_factorization: (K, n) = u_K * (0, sgn n) * prod_{p in P} (0, p)^{v_p(|n|)}
prime_factorization.uniqueness: Unique up to permutation of prime factors in P
prime_factorization.verdict: TC grades do NOT create new primes. The irreducible elements modulo units are in canonical bijection with the native primes P. Realized elements p * tau^K are native primes transported by grade units.

grade_unit_quotient.equivalence_relation: (K, n) ~ (J, m) iff exists A in A_R such that (K, n) = u_A * (J, m) iff n = m
grade_unit_quotient.projection_homomorphism: pi: M_tau -> Z_{!=0}, pi(K, n) = n
grade_unit_quotient.same_referent_interpretation: Each coset in M_tau / U_grade contains all graded representations (K, n) for a single invariant native integer referent n.

canonical_dirichlet_character.definition: chi_s(K, n) = Phi_tau(K, n)^{-s} = tau^{-K*s} * n^{-s}
canonical_dirichlet_character.multiplicativity: chi_s((K, n) * (J, m)) = chi_s(K, n) * chi_s(J, m)
canonical_dirichlet_character.grade_unit_factorization: chi_s(K, n) = chi_s(u_K) * chi_s(0, n) = tau^{-K*s} * n^{-s}
canonical_dirichlet_character.fixed_grade_character_sum: sum_{n=1}^infty chi_s(K, n) = tau^{-K*s} * zeta(s) = D_K[zeta](s)

refined_euler_product.formula: D_K[zeta](s) = chi_s(u_K) * zeta(s) = tau^{-K*s} * prod_{p in P} (1 - p^{-s})^{-1}
refined_euler_product.contrast_with_naive_grid_primes: prod_p (1 - (tau^K p)^{-s})^{-1} = sum tau^{-K Omega(n) s} n^{-s} != tau^{-K s} zeta(s)
refined_euler_product.interpretation: A fixed grade does not possess an independent prime system. The character sum D_K[zeta](s) is the universal native Euler product multiplied by a single global grade-unit twist chi_s(u_K) = tau^{-K*s}.

analytic_action_on_pairs.character_transform: A_K[chi_s(J, n)] = chi_{tau^{-K} s}(J, n) = tau^{-(J * tau^{-K}) * s} * (n^{tau^{-K}})^{-s}

double_escape.grade_coordinate: J * tau^{-K} notin A_R for all K in Q\{0}, J in A_R\{0} (escapes algebraic numbers into transcendental reals)
double_escape.base_coordinate: n^{tau^{-K}} notin Z for all K != 0, n >= 2 (escapes integers into non-integer reals)

rational_grade_escape_theorem.statement: For all K in Q\{0} and J in A_R\{0}, J * tau^{-K} notin A_R.
rational_grade_escape_theorem.proof_summary: If J * tau^{-K} in A_R, then (J * tau^{-K})/J = tau^{-K} in A_R. For K = a/b, (tau^{-a/b})^{-b} = (2pi)^a in A_R, implying pi is algebraic. This contradicts Lindemann (1882).
rational_grade_escape_theorem.scope: Proved unconditionally for all rational grades K and algebraic grades J.

rationale: Algebraic-grade coordinate closure is an imposed convention on the indexing set, not an intrinsic requirement of zeta or TC.
The escape J * tau^{-K} notin A_R is an unconditional property of tau that holds identically whether RH is true or false (delta-independent).
Treating algebraic-grade escape as an RH obstruction is a fallacy of imposed domain restriction.
Analytic dilation naturally escapes into the ambient completion M_tau^{ambient} with no contradiction and no required closure.

minimal_ambient_completion.grade_space: A_R * tau^{A_R} = { J * tau^K : J, K in A_R } subset R
minimal_ambient_completion.base_space: exp(L_tau) where L_tau = span_Z { tau^K * log(p) : K in A_R, p in P } subset R_{>0}
minimal_ambient_completion.ambient_monoid: M_tau^{ambient} = (A_R * tau^{A_R}) x exp(L_tau) subset R x R_{>0}

referent_quotient_preservation.detail: Under analytic dilation, n |-> n^{tau^{-K}} notin Z for n >= 2. However, in log-space, the referent x = log n transforms equivariantly under the continuous dilation flow x |-> tau^{-K} x.

spectral_detector_relation.derivation: Normalized grade unit character is chi_hat_s(u_K) = tau^{-K(s - 1/2)}. At off-critical zero pair (rho, 1 - rho) with rho = 1/2 + delta + i*gamma, |chi_hat_rho(u_K)| = tau^{-K*delta} and |chi_hat_{1-rho}(u_K)| = tau^{K*delta}.
spectral_detector_relation.exact_identity: |chi_hat_rho(u_K)| + |chi_hat_{1-rho}(u_K)| - 2 = tau^{K*delta} + tau^{-K*delta} - 2 = 4 * sinh^2(K * delta * log(tau) / 2) = B_rho(K)
spectral_detector_relation.significance: B_rho(K) is the exact bilateral reflection defect of the grade-unit character under functional equation reflection. It is strictly positive for delta != 0 and vanishes iff delta = 0.

generic_base_control.algebraic_base_closure: For algebraic base b = 2 and K in Q, b^{-K} in A_R, so J * b^{-K} in A_R. Algebraic-grade closure HOLDS for algebraic bases!
generic_base_control.transcendental_base_escape: For transcendental base tau = 2pi, tau^{-K} is transcendental for K in Q\{0}, so J * tau^{-K} notin A_R. Grade escape is specific to transcendental bases.
generic_base_control.detector_universality: B_rho(K; b) = 4 * sinh^2(K * delta * log(b) / 2) holds for any base b > 1.

affine_group_terminology_audit.correction: G_TC = T_{closure} rtimes tau^{A_R} is a countable, dense, proper subgroup of the 2D Lie group Aff_+(R) = R rtimes R_{>0}, not isomorphic to the full Lie group.

earliest_remaining_implication.equation: int_0^infty psi_K(x) d(mu_K^{analytic} - mu_K^{grid})(x) = sum_{rho in Z^+} w_rho * B_rho(K) with w_rho > 0
earliest_remaining_implication.description: Layer 3 of the TC Programme: construct the explicit test function psi_K coupling the prime measure discrepancy functional Delta_K[psi] to the spectral sum of grade-unit reflection defects B_rho(K).

next_task_recommendation: TASK-TC-019: Explicit Formula Contour Integration on the Prime Measure Discrepancy mu_K^{analytic} - mu_K^{grid} and Test-Function Admissibility.
